articles.summary: The Green Chemistry & Commerce Council (GC3), a business-to-business collaborative that drives the commercial adoption of green chemistry, has announced the 10 semi-finalists for the GC3 Startup Network’s 4th Annual Technology Showcase, which will be held May 7, in advance of the annual GC3 Innovators Roundtable on May 8-9 in…
articles.title: The GC3 announces 10 semi-finalists in GC3 Startup Network’s 4th Annual Technology Showcase
